info.description:
Provides functionality for managing the freight orders for subcontracting process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the provider of the API.
Other systems call the defined endpoints within SAP Business Network for Logistics.
info.title: Provider API for Freight Subcontracting

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

post.summary: Creates a carrier response for a freight order
post.description:
Creates a carrier response for a freight order for subcontracting in SAP Business Network for Logistics.
With this functionality, a carrier can confirm or reject a freight order for subcontracting.
When confirming, an alternative price can be proposed, if permitted by the ordering party.
The alternative price is the amount for which the carrier agrees to execute the transportation.
In addition, driver names and details about the vehicle can be provided.
When rejecting, a reason code can be provided.

eu10.description:
To use the EU10 data center API, you must obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret). 
To get the OAuth client credentials, create a customer incident on SAP support portal with the component as SBN-LBN-INT. 
Provide the SAP Business Network for Logistics ID created for your account and the email address to receive your client credentials. 
Specify the target integration platform as ‘Multi-Cloud (new)’ and the title as ‘SAP BN4L Integration Platform Migration: Request for new OAuth 2.0 credential’. 
Once you receive the credentials, pass the details to SAP HANA Cloud Platform token endpoint to obtain an access token.

confirmationStatus.description:
Confirm or reject freight order for subcontracting.
* CN - Confirm freight order for subcontracting
* RE - Reject freight order for subcontracting

driver1Name.description:
Name of driver assigned to truck (two drivers can be assigned).
It is not supported for consignment orders.

driver2Name.description:
Name of driver assigned to truck (two drivers can be assigned).
It is not supported for consignment orders.

trailerID.description:
Identifier of the trailer that will execute the order. 
It is not supported for consignment orders.

truckID.description:
Identifier of the truck that will execute the order. 
It is not supported for consignment orders.

transportMeansID.description:
Vehicle license plate of the truck that will execute the order.
It is not supported for consignment orders.

transportMeansHomeCountryCode.description:
Country code of vehicle license plate, specified in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 – two-character country code format.
It is not supported for consignment orders.

rejectionReasonCode.description:
The reason (code) selected by the carrier to explain why they rejected the freight order for subcontracting.
Should be used together with `confirmationStatus` when confirmation status `RE` is provided.
* LBN_CAPA - No capacity
* LBN_OTHERS - Other
* LBN_PRICE - Price
* LBN_TIME - No time

attachments.description: Attachments can be provided by the carrier in Base 64 encoded format

businessDocumentReferences.description: A unique reference to other business documents that are of significance within each respective business process.

CarrierPartyLbnId.description: Identifier of the carrier within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

networkPartnerLBNID.description: Identifier of the network partner within SAP Business Network for Logistics.

areaID.description:
The area code associated with the mobile phone number.
It is not supported for consignment orders.

subscriberID.description:
The mobile phone number of the assigned driver.
It is not supported for consignment orders.

countryDiallingCode.description:
The country code associated with the mobile phone number. 
It is not supported for consignment orders.

value.description: Amount that the carrier proposes for executing a freight order for subcontracting.

currency.description: Format must be compliant with SAP Global Data Type `CurrencyCode` (`listID` = `4217`, `listAgencyID` = `5`). [Codelist](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_LBN_FC_OPTION/40f43410e8a64dc98792a5e610e81017/c5ff86c3b2c744b4aab2ade9d9b1f05e.html)

PostFreightOrderForSubcontractingCarrier.description:
Amount that the carrier proposes for executing a freight order for subcontracting.
Price proposal can be used to propose an alternative price in case property `priceIsNegotiable` is `true`.
Price proposal is considered only if the freight order for subcontracting is confirmed (`confirmationStatus` = `CN`).
In other cases it is ignored.

text.description:
Natural-language text with additional information about the freight order for subcontracting.
The note is language-independent.

containerId.description: Identifier of the container that will be used by the ordering party for tracking purposes.

name.description: Name of the attachment along with the file extension.

mimeCode.description:
Content type code of the attachment.
* image/jpeg - Mime code for image files with .jpeg extension
* image/jpg - Mime code for image files with .jpg extension
* image/png - Mime code for image files with .png extension
* image/gif - Mime code for image files with .gif extension
* image/tiff - Mime code for image files with .tiff extension
* image/tiff-fx - Mime code for image files with .tiff-fx extension
* application/pdf - Mime code for files with .pdf extension
* application/msword - Mime code for files with .doc extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document - Mime code for files with .docx extension
* application/vnd.ms-excel - Mime code for files with .xls extension
* application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet - Mime code for files with .xlsx extension
